en: A black-and-white, vintage view of an ornate suspension bridge crossing a wide river in a European city. The bridge has highly decorated steel towers with finials and elaborate latticework, and massive stone pylons with stairways and sculptures at the riverbank. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing and a few carriages or early vehicles move along the bridge and the adjoining promenade. On the far bank stand multi‑story European buildings, and to the left a church with twin spires rises above the riverfront. The image corners are damaged and irregular, reinforcing the feel of an old postcard or photograph. No legible printed caption is visible.
